about.summary: Coalinga College, formerly West Hills College Coalinga, is a public community college in Coalinga, California, with a satellite facility in Firebaugh. Both locations serve students in the central San Joaquin Valley. Established in 1932, Coalinga College is in the West Hills Community College District. It is accredited by the Accrediting Commission for Community and Junior Colleges.

ir_office.summary: The page provides an overview of the Institutional Effectiveness office at West Hills Community College District. It includes contact information for Kyle Crider and general resources related to institutional research. The page lists links to various state, regional, federal, and national data resources.

documents.title: Institutional Data | West Hills Community College District
documents.summary: The Institutional Data page at West Hills Community College District provides definitions of key metrics used for assessing and reporting on educational performance. These include Enrollment, Success Rate, Course Completion, Persistence, Weekly Student Contact Hours, Full-Time Equivalent Faculty, and WSCH/FTEF. Each metric is essential for evaluating student outcomes and resource allocation within the institution.

documents.title: Coalinga College Strategic Plan
documents.summary: The Coalinga College Strategic Plan is part of the West Hills Community College District's planning efforts for the years 2021 to 2026. It outlines the strategic initiatives and focus areas for Coalinga College, aligning with district-level goals to support student success and institutional development. The plan is informed by previous strategic frameworks and hopes to address both current opportunities and future challenges by tailoring strategies unique to the institution.
